# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

All Rights Reserved. ## Larry Cohen **CHIEF CUSTOMER ADVOCATE** Larry Cohen graduated from Wilkes College with a B.S. in Accounting in 1957 and Columbia University Graduate School of Business, earning an M.S. in Management and Finance, 1958. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. [Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[EpicShare]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

## Health Systems Worldwide

[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## What Happened to SmileDirectClub?

SmileSet has acquired SmileDirectClub's groundbreaking technology and assets, incorporating their
innovative patents and manufacturing systems into our established business. Experience the same
trusted technology that has transformed over 2 million smiles worldwide, now enhanced with
SmileSet's comprehensive approach to orthodontic care.

## Former SmileDirectClub Customer?

As a former SmileDirectClub client, you may qualify for special, deep discounts! Watch out for
messages from our team or reach out to us here so we can get your smile set.
Aligners

SmileSet offers Aligner Treatments for former SmileDirectClub customers. We provide a special **$800
discount** for former SDC customers to help you continue your smile journey with clear aligners. Our
state-licensed dental professionals will create a new treatment plan tailored to your current smile
position to support you every step of the way.

[Get Started][10]
[ [Clear dental aligner on a black surface with white background] ][11]

SmileDirectClub's former dental professionals have partnered with SmileSet to **make it easy and
affordable for former SDC customers to get retainers**. Order your custom retainers *on subscription
*with SmileSet to help preserve your smile. If you're a former customer you can get deep discounts
on subscription because you likely won't need any additional 3D scans or putty impressions.

[Order Retainers][12]
Oral Care

SmileSet offers a complete line of **truly premium oral care products** to keep your smile bright
and healthy. Ranging from **toothbrushes** and **floss** to **whitening** and appliance **cleaners**
we help keep your dental assets in mint condition. Plus, we still offer the SmileDirectClub customer
favored lip balm!

## Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? We've got answers. Here are the most common questions about SmileSet.

What happened to SmileDirectClub?

SmileDirectClub ceased operations in 2023. SmileSet acquired their technology and assets, allowing
us to incorporate their innovative platform into our comprehensive approach to smile care.

Is SmileSet the same thing as SmileDirectClub?

No. SmileSet is a distinct business entity that purchased SmileDirectClub's assets. While we
acquired their technological innovations, SmileSet operates with our own distinct business practices
and customer commitments.

I was a former SmileDirectClub customer, what's this mean for me?

As part of our technology acquisition, SmileSet now supports some of the licensed dental
professionals who worked with SmileDirectClub. This means you can order SmileSet retainers or night
guards without needing new impressions in most cases. For aligner treatment, we require new
impressions to ensure the best possible outcome. While we cannot honor SmileDirectClub's previous
guarantees or warranties, we are offering special discounts on aligners for former SDC customers to
help you continue your smile journey.

Can I continue my treatment if I was mid-treatment with SmileDirectClub?

For your safety and the best possible outcome, our dental professionals need to create a treatment
plan based on your current smile position. We can't simply continue a treatment plan created by
another company as this could compromise your results.

We understand this is a difficult situation, and we want to help. That's why we offer a special
discount for former SDC customers because we understand you've already invested in your smile
journey and we're committed to helping you achieve your smile goals.

Will SmileSet honor SmileDirectClub's lifetime smile guarantee?

Yes! Our clear aligners apply the same effective pressure as braces, but without the metal wires.

How does the treatment process work?

Our process begins with an impression kit or 3D scan (if you are located in NYC or Nashville). Your
images are reviewed by a state-licensed dental professional who creates your custom treatment plan.
Your aligners are manufactured using the same advanced technology that has successfully transformed
millions of smiles and delivered to your door.

## Dr. Katz created TheraBreath products because he thought your mouth needed a friend.

Dr. Katz began his breakthrough research into the causes of bad breath in the early 1990s after he
was unable to help his teenage daughter with her bad breath.

A UCLA-trained dentist and bacteriologist, Dr. Katz rolled up his sleeves and got to work finding a
solution. The result was the first TheraBreath formula, a safe, efficacious solution for bad breath.

## Dr. Katz created TheraBreath products because he thought your mouth needed a friend.

Dr. Katz began his breakthrough research into the causes of bad breath in the early 1990s after he

01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## Your Longevity Starts With What You Can Measure Today

##### BIOXPACE - HEALTHY LONGEVITY PROGRAM

**Comprehensive longevity assessment and personalized interventions targeting the molecular drivers
of aging, designed to optimize healthspan and extend vitality.**

**BIOXPACE** is an integrated molecular longevity protocol that provides a personalized biological
map of aging, designed to guide active prevention strategies, functional optimization, and targeted
therapeutic interventions.

Through **advanced molecular testing developed by Bioscience Institute** and integrated into a
digital clinical platform, BIOXPACE enables the early detection of subtle yet impactful alterations
– including genotoxic stress, cellular senescence, immune dysfunction, and microbiome imbalance –
long before clinical manifestations appear.

[Discover more][127]

## Intercepting Cancer Before It Develops

##### HELIXAFE - Epigenetics and Genomics of Carcinogenesis

**HELIXAFE** is an **advanced prevention model** that analyzes the molecular and genomic factors
underlying the earliest steps of carcinogenesis. Through comprehensive profiling of inflammatory
pathways, microbiome composition, genomic stability, and immune regulation, HELIXAFE identifies
subtle biological imbalances that may contribute to cancer-enabling conditions long before disease
develops.

This multidimensional approach is structured into four dedicated modules: **CYTOBALANCE** for
pro-inflammatory cytokine monitoring, **MICROBALANCE** for gut and vaginal microbiome assessment,
**HELIXBALANCE** for genome instability evaluation, and **IMMUNEBALANCE** for immune system balance
analysis. Together, these pillars provide a detailed overview of your biological landscape and
support personalized, science-driven prevention strategies.

[Discover more][128]

## Science-Powered Regeneration for Life and Wellness

##### CELLSKILS - Stem Cells Banking and MSCs Treatments

**Bioscience Institute offers an integrated portfolio of regenerative solutions based on Mesenchymal
Stem Cells and MSC-derived exosomes, covering aesthetic, clinical, and functional applications.**

**Our Aesthetic Stem Cells treatments** harness laboratory-expanded MSCs to naturally rejuvenate
skin, restore volume, regenerate hair, and address intimate wellness. **The Regenerative Stem Cells
protocols** target deeper clinical needs, supporting tissue repair, immune modulation,
anti-inflammatory pathways, and recovery in degenerative or functional conditions.

Complementing these cell-based therapies, **our Exosomes Treatments** deliver high-potency bioactive
signals that enhance regeneration, improve skin quality, boost hair restoration, support joint
function, and promote overall vitality. Together, these three pillars offer a comprehensive,
science-based approach to regeneration and long-term well-being.

[Discover more][129]

## Comprehensive Genetic Testing for Your Family's Health

##### ULTRANIPT - Advanced genetic screening for pregnancy and newborn health.

Bioscience Institute offers **expanded prenatal and neonatal screening** using **cell-free fetal
DNA** and state-of-the-art genomic technologies.
These advanced tests help identify **genetic**, **chromosomal**, and **metabolic conditions** early
in life, supporting informed decisions throughout pregnancy and ensuring timely, targeted care for
newborns.

Our comprehensive platform includes **NIPT – Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing** to screen for
chromosomal abnormalities from week 10, **Carrier Screening** to identify inherited disease risks
before or during early pregnancy, and **Neonatal Screening** to detect treatable conditions in the
first days of life. Together, these solutions provide a complete pathway for **mother**, **father**,
and **newborn**, ensuring the highest standards of safety and clinical reliability.

[Discover more][130]

therapeutic interventions.

underlying the earliest steps of carcinogenesis. Through comprehensive profiling of inflammatory

subtle biological imbalances that may contribute to cancer-enabling conditions long before disease

### Built for Students

Purpose-built for education, not a general-purpose AI. Every feature is designed to help kids learn
safely and responsibly.

### Strong Privacy Protection

Student data is protected with strict privacy safeguards and industry-leading security standards.

### Age-Appropriate Guidance

Responses are adjusted to the student’s age and grade level. Explanations use language, examples,
and steps that match what students at that stage of school are expected to understand.

### Ethically Designed

Support is judgment-free and encouraging—like a patient, trusted mentor helping students learn.

science to stop cavities before they start. Our formulas protect enamel, restore balance, and help
you feel confident in your smile every day.

Safe to use every day, our dentist-developed products are highly effective and scientifically proven
to prevent cavities. We’re here to help you become cavity-free for life!

## Antibacterial & Acidity Reduction

Lower your risk by addressing the overpopulation of cavity-causing bacteria in the mouth.

Neutralize acids in the biofilm and promote better oral health with products that have pH ranges
above neutral.

nano-hydroxyapatite (nanoXIM by FLUIDINOVA).

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by

healthy.

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

**Decisions Advisors** is a comprehensive market research and consulting company that provides
actionable insights based on data. We deal with businesses from various industries and deliver a

bespoke consulting for our clients.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find quick answers to common questions about our services and offerings.

### In what formats can I download the ordered reports?

Reports are available in Microsoft Word, PDF, and PowerPoint formats for user convenience.

### How do I get the receipt of my purchases?

A detailed invoice is automatically sent to your registered email after successful payment

### What do single user, multi-user and enterprise license mean?
* **Single User License:** Access for one individual.
* **Multi-User License:** Access for a few users within the same organization.
* **Enterprise License:** Unlimited access across the entire organization.

### Are samples available for all studies?

Yes, sample reports are available on request to help you assess the report’s quality and structure.

We use expert validation, triangulation, and multi-step quality checks to ensure data accuracy and

# European Market Entry & Business Expansion Services

 

**Sales, HR (EOR/PEO) and Digital Marketing Solutions for North American Companies Expanding into
Europe**

Expanding into Europe is complex, but **EuroDev helps North American companies** enter, scale, and
operate successfully across Europe with local execution, regulatory confidence, and measurable
results.

[Explore our European expansion services][29]
[business development outsourcing]

## Trusted European Expansion Partner Since 1996

**With over 25 years of experience and more than 500 successful partnerships,** EuroDev supports
North American companies navigating the commercial, regulatory, and operational realities of Europe.

From first market entry to long‑term growth, we act as your **local execution partner on the ground
in Europe**.

25

Years of experience

500+

Satisfied clients

75

European colleagues

## Our European Expansion Services

### **A Unified System for Entering and Scaling in Europe**

Successful European expansion requires more than one service. EuroDev provides an integrated
approach that supports every stage of your growth.


[
[sales-outsouring-eurodev]

### Sales Outsourcing Services in Europe

**Build pipeline, generate revenue, and enter new markets with confidence**
 
Our European sales teams help you:
* Develop entry strategies for European markets
* Generate qualified leads and build pipelines
* Manage local sales outreach and distributor relationships
* Convert opportunities into long‑term revenue
Learn more about our Sales Outsourcing services in Europe

* Payroll, contracts, and labour compliance
* HR consultancy for multi‑country operations
Explore HR outsourcing and EOR services in Europe

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

# KYT Dental Services

Keep Your Teeth starts with better decisions.

Modern PPO dentist in Fountain Valley. We explain your options before you decide. No pressure.

[KYT Dental Services — comprehensive dental care including implants, imaging, treatment planning,
and insurance]

§ 01 · Start here

## What brings you in?

Start where you are. We'll point you in the right direction.

[
Start here

I have tooth pain.

Pain, pressure, sensitivity, or swelling. Figure out what you're dealing with.

Implants, bridges, and partial dentures. What each option involves and what affects the decision.

Learn about tooth replacement →][14][
Path

I want to use my PPO insurance.

treatment.

PPO insurance info →][15][
Path

I do not have dental insurance.

KYT offers membership plans with no waiting periods, no annual maximums, and no claim forms.

Membership and pricing →][16]

§ 02 · Approach

## What makes KYT different.

Not every dental office approaches care the same way. Here is what distinguishes how KYT works.

### Tooth preservation first

We look for ways to save a tooth before removing it. Extraction is a last resort, not a default.

### Full-mouth planning

We evaluate the whole picture (bite, bone, gums, and existing work) not just the tooth that hurts.

### CBCT + iTero scanning

3D cone beam imaging and digital scanning for diagnoses that 2D X-rays alone can miss.

### Clear explanations

What we found, what it means, and what we recommend. In plain English, before anything is scheduled.

### PPO + membership

We accept most major PPO plans and offer a membership plan for patients without insurance.

### Same-day emergency care

Tooth pain, broken tooth, lost crown. Same-day appointments available for urgent situations.

§ 03 · Reviews

## What patients notice.

These themes show up in Google and Healthgrades reviews again and again.

[Read reviews →][17]

### Calm visits

Unhurried appointments. No upselling, no pressure to schedule on the spot.

### Clear explanations

What was found, what it means, and what your options are — in plain English.

### Written estimates

Out-of-pocket, insurance applied, and financing options before anything is scheduled.

### Dr. Sun every time

You see the same dentist every visit. Continuity of judgment across your care.

[Read reviews →][18]

§ 04 · Services

## Services.

Care for urgent problems, long-term planning, and everything in between.

[All services →][19]
[
Service01

### Emergency Care

Same-day appointments for tooth pain, broken teeth, lost crowns, and swelling.

Learn more →][20][
Service02

### Preventive Care

Exams, cleanings, and early detection. The foundation of long-term tooth retention.

Learn more →][21][
Service03

### Crowns & Restorations

Same-day zirconia crowns, inlays, onlays, and composite restorations.

Learn more →][22][
Service04

### Gum Disease Treatment

Deep cleanings, periodontal maintenance, and long-term gum health management.

Learn more →][23][
Service05

### Dental Implants

Single tooth, multiple teeth, and implant-supported restorations.

Learn more →][24][
Service06

### Invisalign

Clear aligner therapy for bite correction and cosmetic alignment.

Learn more →][25][
Service07

### Full Mouth Reconstruction

Comprehensive treatment planning for patients with complex or failing dentition.

Learn more →][26]

§ 05 · KYT Framework

## Before we recommend treatment, we look at the whole picture.

The tooth. The bite. The gum support. The bone level. The existing restorations. The KYT Framework
is the structured system we use to evaluate these variables together, so that treatment
recommendations are based on your full situation, not a single finding.

including cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, and preventative care. Whether your needs include
dental veneers, crowns, routine teeth cleaning, or emergency dental services, our full-service

We understand that visiting the dentist can sometimes cause anxiety, which is why our Batavia office
is designed with your comfort in mind. Our facility offers a warm, welcoming environment featuring
modern equipment and gentle techniques to ensure your visit is as pleasant as possible. Conveniently

listen to your concerns, explain treatment options, and develop individualized care plans that
address your specific needs and goals. New patients are always welcome at Batavia Dental Care, and
we offer consultations to discuss how we can help you achieve and maintain optimal oral health for
years to come.

## Transform Your Smile & Boost Your Confidence: Batavia Dentist Expert in Cosmetic Solutions

[https://marcovcolelladmd.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/2.jpg]

As your cosmetic dentist in Batavia, I believe a beautiful smile can change your entire outlook on
life. At Marco V. Colella, DMD, PLLC, I’ve witnessed countless transformations that go far beyond
aesthetics – from the professional who finally conquered presentation anxiety after addressing years
of dental insecurity, to the parent who can’t stop smiling in family photos after completing their
cosmetic treatment.

I’m passionate about bringing the most innovative cosmetic dental techniques to our Batavia
community. Every advanced technique we implement serves one purpose: helping you achieve the
confident smile you’ve always wanted. Whether you’re considering professional teeth whitening,
porcelain veneers, or a complete smile makeover, my commitment to excellence ensures you’ll receive
the most personalized cosmetic dental care available in Batavia.

When you choose our practice for your cosmetic dentistry needs, you’re not just getting a treatment
– you’re getting a dedicated partner in your smile transformation journey. Your dream smile deserves
nothing less than our very best, and that’s exactly what we deliver.

[Explore Cosmetic Dental Services →][24]

## Restore Your Smile and Confidence: Batavia Dentist for Life-Changing Dental Implants

[https://marcovcolelladmd.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/3.jpg]

As a specialized dentist in Batavia focusing on dental implants, I’ve helped countless patients
regain their confident smiles. One of my most memorable cases was a local professional who had
struggled with missing teeth for years. After receiving dental implants at our Batavia office, she
shared that she finally felt like herself again – able to enjoy family meals, speak confidently in
meetings, and smile without hesitation.

At Marco V. Colella, DMD, PLLC, our advanced approach to dental implants goes beyond just replacing
missing teeth. Using state-of-the-art digital imaging and precise techniques, I ensure each implant
is perfectly placed for optimal function and natural appearance. Whether you need a single tooth
replaced or are considering more comprehensive restoration, our tailored dental implant solutions
address your unique needs.

As your Batavia dentist for implants, I take pride in delivering life-changing results with the
personalized attention you deserve. From your initial consultation through your final restoration,
you’ll experience the difference that 12 years of dental expertise brings to your care journey.

[Explore Dental Implant Solutions →][25]

[https://marcovcolelladmd.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4.jpg]

## Dental Pain? Get Fast Relief Today: Batavia Dentist Providing Emergency Care When It Matters Most

[https://marcovcolelladmd.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4.jpg]

dental service provider in Batavia, I understand that dental emergencies don’t wait for convenient
hours. That’s why at Marco V. Colella, DMD, PLLC, we offer prompt emergency care for our Batavia
community, often providing same-day appointments for patients in severe pain.

Just last week, I helped a busy professional who cracked a tooth during dinner – by the next
morning, she was back at work, comfortable and ready for her important presentation. Whether you’re
dealing with a severe toothache, a broken crown, or a dental trauma, our Batavia emergency dental
service is equipped to handle your urgent needs. I keep appointment slots open specifically for
emergency cases, ensuring you don’t have to endure prolonged pain or risk further complications.

Using advanced diagnostic tools and years of emergency care experience, I quickly identify the
source of your discomfort and provide immediate relief. At our Batavia location, you’ll receive not
just rapid treatment, but compassionate care that addresses both your immediate pain and long-term
dental health. Because when you’re facing a dental emergency in Batavia, you deserve a dentist who’s
ready to help – when you need it most.

Medical bills can be confusing, needlessly expensive, and sometimes downright incorrect. Our team

# Get the insurance reimbursement you deserve.

Medical Bill Gurus helps patients and providers navigate the insurance maze — from claim preparation
to persistent follow-up — so you recover what you're owed.

[Get a Free Consultation][11] [How It Works][12]
[Medical Bill Gurus logo]
No fee unless we recover
We work on a 25% contingency basis — you only pay when we successfully secure your reimbursement.
**20+ yrs**Billing & advocacy experience
**Nationwide**Patients & providers across the U.S.
**Out-of-Network**Specialists in OON reimbursement
**Contingency**No recovery, no fee
What We Do

## Comprehensive billing & advocacy services

We act as a third-party medical billing, coding, and collections service — handling everything from
claim submission to follow-ups so you maximize your benefits.

P

### Patient Advocacy

We review your bills, build a custom reimbursement strategy, and pursue your out-of-network claims
so you don't pay more than you should.

B

### Provider Billing

Turnkey revenue cycle management for practices — coding, claim submission, denials, and collections
handled by specialists.

O

### Out-of-Network Claims

We specialize in helping patients self-submit and recover for treatment received from out-of-network
and integrative providers.

Why Choose Us

## Experience that gets results

Medical bills can be confusing, needlessly expensive, and sometimes downright incorrect. Our team
navigates the complex structures of the insurance process on your behalf.
* Over 20 years of reimbursement experience
* Specialists in holistic and integrative treatment claims
* End-to-end handling: preparation, submission, and follow-up
* Checks issued directly to the policyholder
* Risk-free: no recovery means no fee

[Learn More About Us][13]

### How reimbursement works

#### Send us your bills

Share your medical bills and a signed HIPAA release.

#### We build a strategy

We identify reimbursable line items and prepare your claim.

#### You get reimbursed

When a check arrives, we invoice our contingency percentage.

## Ready to see what you can recover?

Get a free, no-obligation case evaluation. Our experts will review your situation and tell you if
you qualify.

[Get a Free Consultation][14]

reimbursement — with over 20 years of experience.

## What Is Prosthodontics?

### Dr. Ben on the Importance of Prosthodontics

Prosthodontics is the field of dental specialty involving advanced restorative treatments and tooth
replacement, including crowns, bridges, veneers, dentures, and implants. When you need to repair or
replace a tooth, our prosthodontist can ensure that you receive the highest quality of care.

[Learn More][129]

## What Our Patients Are Saying

### Read Our Patient Success Stories

## Why Should You Refer To A Prosthodontist?

### Experience the Pantops Prosthodontics Difference

Dr. Ben Ross and Dr. Dr. Sharon Vincenty is specially trained to handle complex and extensive
restorative procedures with precision and skill. When you need significant reconstructive procures
to deal with challenging dental problems, our prosthodontist can provide the personalized service
you need!

### Patient
### Information

Pantops Prosthodontics offers several resources to help you prepare for your appointment with our
prosthodontist. Please follow this link to learn more.

][128]

## What Is Prosthodontics?

### Dr. Ben on the Importance of Prosthodontics

Prosthodontics is the field of dental specialty involving advanced restorative treatments and tooth
replacement, including crowns, bridges, veneers, dentures, and implants. When you need to repair or
replace a tooth, our prosthodontist can ensure that you receive the highest quality of care.

[Learn More][129]

## What Our Patients Are Saying

### Read Our Patient Success Stories

## Why Should You Refer To A Prosthodontist?

### Experience the Pantops Prosthodontics Difference

Dr. Ben Ross and Dr. Dr. Sharon Vincenty is specially trained to handle complex and extensive
restorative procedures with precision and skill. When you need significant reconstructive procures
to deal with challenging dental problems, our prosthodontist can provide the personalized service
you need!

## Частые вопросы

[1.Врач выявил осложненный кариес, насколько это опасно?][92]

Осложненный кариес – запущенный кариозный процесс в полости рта. Необходимо срочно начать лечение,
иначе болезнь перейдет в пульпит или периодонтит. Эти заболевания могут привести к полной утрате
зуба.

[2.В ротовой полости периодически появляются язвы, как с ними бороться?][93]

При обнаружении язвы необходимо показаться стоматологу, особенно если поднялась температура, язвы не
проходят более двух недель, мешают принимать пищу, или стали появляться чаще и в больших
количествах.

[3.Болит зуб мудрости, его нужно удалить или лучше провести лечение?][94]

Зубы мудрости – восьмой зуб в ряду. Они часто поражаются кариесом, так как уход за ними затруднен.
Лечение его нецелесообразно, лучше удалить. В случае, если рост зуба происходит без осложнений, его
можно оставить. Окончательное решение после консультации врача остается за пациентом. Если зуб
мудрости болит, то врач вначале выяснит причину, а затем посоветует, что делать.

[4.Опухла щека, это может быть амелобластома?][95]

Амелобластома – доброкачественная опухоль, поражающая нижнюю челюсть. При отсутствии лечения,
опухоль увеличивается и может перейти в злокачественный вариант. Поставить правильный диагноз может
только врач, поэтому необходимо записаться на прием.

## Частые вопросы

[1.Врач выявил осложненный кариес, насколько это опасно?][92]

Осложненный кариес – запущенный кариозный процесс в полости рта. Необходимо срочно начать лечение,
иначе болезнь перейдет в пульпит или периодонтит. Эти заболевания могут привести к полной утрате
зуба.

[2.В ротовой полости периодически появляются язвы, как с ними бороться?][93]

При обнаружении язвы необходимо показаться стоматологу, особенно если поднялась температура, язвы не
проходят более двух недель, мешают принимать пищу, или стали появляться чаще и в больших
количествах.

[3.Болит зуб мудрости, его нужно удалить или лучше провести лечение?][94]

Зубы мудрости – восьмой зуб в ряду. Они часто поражаются кариесом, так как уход за ними затруднен.
Лечение его нецелесообразно, лучше удалить. В случае, если рост зуба происходит без осложнений, его
можно оставить. Окончательное решение после консультации врача остается за пациентом. Если зуб
мудрости болит, то врач вначале выяснит причину, а затем посоветует, что делать.

[4.Опухла щека, это может быть амелобластома?][95]

Амелобластома – доброкачественная опухоль, поражающая нижнюю челюсть. При отсутствии лечения,
опухоль увеличивается и может перейти в злокачественный вариант. Поставить правильный диагноз может
только врач, поэтому необходимо записаться на прием.
